description: An DataInsight Agent that autonomously executes tasks and processes information using tools like Excel for advanced data manipulation, analysis, and visualization; calculators for precise computations; and PDF tools for document extraction—facilitating financial modeling, data organization, document analysis, and delivery of actionable insights across diverse applications.

tools.name: ExcelTool
tools.description: A tool for advanced data manipulation, analysis, and visualization using Excel spreadsheets, allowing for complex calculations and data organization.

tools.name: CalculatorTool
tools.description: A precise computation tool that performs mathematical calculations and provides numerical results for various inputs.

tools.name: PDFExtractorTool
tools.description: A tool for extracting text and data from PDF documents, enabling analysis and processing of financial reports and other documents.

tools.name: DataVisualizationTool
tools.description: A tool for creating visual representations of data, helping to communicate insights effectively through charts and graphs.

tools.name: DataAnalysisTool
tools.description: A tool designed for analyzing datasets to uncover trends, patterns, and insights, facilitating informed decision-making.

tools.name: FinancialModelingTool
tools.description: A specialized tool for building financial models, allowing for forecasting, budgeting, and scenario analysis.

tools.name: DataOrganizationTool
tools.description: A tool for structuring and organizing data efficiently, ensuring that information is easily accessible and manageable.
